subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this opt-in durable-core runtime and internal wake-to-session delivery architecture for the 2026.7.1 release line?
rationale: The cumulative branch adds a persisted runtime, operator protocol, environment controls, and startup recovery policy; code review cannot determine whether that product and release commitment is intended.

options.title: Sponsor the stack
options.body: Approve the architecture in principle, then require the CI pin and exact-head live generation-fence proof before landing the coordinated series.

options.title: Retarget after release
options.body: Keep the design but move it off the 2026.7.1 release line for separately planned main-branch integration.

options.title: Decline durable core
options.body: Close the stack if OpenClaw does not want to own this runtime and recovery surface in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture in principle, then require the CI pin and exact-head live generation-fence proof before landing the coordinated series.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-backed routing candidate for the existing session-delivery queue and its lifecycle contract.
